caseName: Gen. Elec. Co. v. Raytheon Techs. Corp.
caseNameFull: GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY v. RAYTHEON TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION, fka United Technologies Corporation.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit denied. Justice Breyer and Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
